what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Djibouti, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13853 Somali refugees in Djibouti, 1.6% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in 1984, from 1986 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1990 and 1991, fall within the first of these periods.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1989 at 29960 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 84628, at the end of 1991, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Djibouti.
These are year-end totals for Djibouti only, reported to UNHCR.
